name: Gasthof Weberbauer
beschreibung: The Gasthof Weberbauer is a traditional inn in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in Tirol. The accommodation is located in the center of Scheffau. The surroundings are shaped by the Kaisergebirge. The atmosphere in the house is down-to-earth and family-friendly. Guests can expect accommodation with simply furnished rooms. The restaurant serves Tiroler Spezialitäten. Hiking trails and ski lifts are reachable from the accommodation.
